title: SAR Doppler tomography paper on Vesuvius with the National Research Council of Italy

tellings.quote: um under the Vesuvius and I wrote a paper was very very nice paper and

plain: Filippo Biondi, a researcher who scans underground structures with satellite radar (known as SAR), says he looked beneath Mount Vesuvius near Naples with this method in 2019. He says he wrote it up in a paper, "a very very nice paper," with the National Research Council of Italy. He tells Michels about it as the earlier work behind his later radar scans beneath the pyramids.
